selected_headlines: Martin, St. Lucie, Palm Beach voters to decide eight local ballot questions Nov. 3
source_headlines: From parks bonds to trash pickup: Local questions facing Palm Beach, Treasure Coast voters - cw34.com
novel_facts: Three Palm Beach County questions: $280 million parks bonds, $175 million library bonds, and 1-mill school levy continuation
Palm Beach County parks bonds would fund modernizing parks, recreation facilities, botanical gardens, sports complexes, beach access
Library bonds would be repaid over 20 years through property taxes
School levy would run July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2031 for safety, mental health, arts/music teachers
St. Lucie surtax would extend for 10 years from Jan 2028
Confirms Indian River and Okeechobee counties have no local ballot questions
